capability.title: Shopping cart
capability.description: Maintains persistent guest and customer shopping carts with product quantities and price calculation.

capability.title: Checkout
capability.description: Provides configurable checkout flows for customer data, delivery, payment and order submission.

capability.title: Order management
capability.description: Creates and manages orders with processing, payment and shipping statuses, history and notifications.

capability.title: Order self-service
capability.description: Lets customers review current and past orders, continue unpaid orders and access available documents.

capability.title: Order invoicing
capability.description: Creates draft or posted invoices from orders manually or automatically based on order and payment state.

capability.title: E-commerce tracking
capability.description: Supplies product, cart, checkout and purchase event data to the QUIQQER data layer.
